title: UP Micro-Irrigation Project
description: The Uttar Pradesh Micro-Irrigation Project aims to expand irrigated areas and help farmers adopt efficient irrigation systems such as drip and sprinkler irrigation.

title: Farmer Financial Assistance
description: Financial institutions can support farmers by providing affordable loans for irrigation equipment and agricultural infrastructure.

title: Water Conservation Initiative
description: Modern irrigation technologies help conserve water, increase crop productivity, and improve agricultural sustainability.
